markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, second-model agreement and 5/5 similar cases all agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu <1% | Strongly one-sided |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% / 24th percentile | Typical input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · Strongest concept association with invasive carcinoma · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Score low here, which fits invasive · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 4, 7, 9) · context · Above typical; descriptive only · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 2, 10) · ↑ invasive · Score above typical, but failed spot check (0/20) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Removing top concept regions: CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect classifier use. Mitoses Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Stain degradation (simulated, severity 3) distorts concept scores despite high reliability.
- Calibration comes from 132 test images (ECE 5%, upper CI 18%); read 100% as "very high".

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 8, 9:** confirm carcinoma cells infiltrating stroma. [F2]
2. **Regions 1, 2, 10:** count mitoses yourself; model score failed its spot check. [F4]
3. **Regions 0–4, 7–11:** verify tumor at all four margins (simulated frozen section). [F7]
